name: shiftora-site
description: The three-page institutional site for Shiftora.

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && node scripts/verify-rebrand.mjs && node scripts/test-font-policy.mjs && node scripts/verify-production-server.mjs
scripts.verify:deploy: npm run verify && npm run audit:all && node scripts/verify-fonts.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:deploy && npm run verify:visual:release
